title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Add more fields and columns by personalizing pages
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 adds more fields and columns available for personalization on various pages, including Statistics Group, Allow Multiple Posting Groups, Price Calculation Method, and alternate address fields on sales, purchase, and service documents.
key_points: Users can now personalize more pages by selecting from expanded field lists to display information relevant to their workflows
New fields include Statistics Group on card pages, Allow Multiple Posting Groups and Price Calculation Method on Customer Template, and alternate address fields on sales and purchase documents
Alternate address fields appear only when documents are configured to use alternate or custom addresses instead of defaults
This enhancement continues Microsoft's ongoing effort to add personalization options based on community feedback across major updates
features: Sell-to Customer Name 2 on project documents
shipping and billing details on service documents
